ctor.rationale: `base(0, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.Self)` (Rage.cs:20-23) == cost 0 / SKILL / UNCOMMON / SELF.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DynamicVar("Power", 3m)` (Rage.cs:16) == `_power_amount = 3`, stored in the slot `magic_number` reads -- the correct storage for a generic named power var, contrast card/feel_no_pain, which put the same shape of number in `_block`.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<RagePower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars["Power"].BaseValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (Rage.cs:28) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, RagePower, self._power_amount, applier=ctx.player)`. Presentation, folded in: TriggerAnim (27) and the Block hover tip (18) -- and note the card does NOT override GainsBlock, because RagePower grants the block, not the card, so the sim's False default is right.
